## Change

Work-order ID (AF-___), actual executor, owner decisions, changed paths, dependency verification, source SHA and the smallest complete improvement. State explicitly whether this is **planning only**, **native-boot only**, or **actual gameplay/art/device** work.

## Tests performed (exact commands and results)

- [ ] Structure validator and production queue validator run (or explain why not)
- [ ] Queue-history transition audit passes against previously committed baseline (or first-adoption exception documented)
- [ ] New functional/security/regression tests added and results shown
- [ ] Native Godot project opened and main scene run (only check if really performed)
- [ ] Native Blender import/export tested (if relevant)
- [ ] Physical device tested (if relevant)

## Art and evidence

- [ ] No approved reference artwork overwritten
- [ ] Original art and exported GLB stored separately
- [ ] Genuine screenshots/video/hashes attached when actual visual/runtime change is claimed
- [ ] Not-run or blocked checks clearly identified

## Review and protected source

- [ ] Real human reviewer identified for any claim of VERIFIED (include `reviewed_by`), not just a PR approval checkbox
- [ ] No deleted/renamed historical tasks, modified approved requirements, stale proof or secret-containing files
- [ ] No new unapproved paid services, agents, deployments or proprietary third-party game content
- [ ] Required GitHub branch rules checked separately; CODEOWNERS alone is not enforcement

## Risks / rollback

State known limitations and exact revert instructions. No auto-deploy or merge.
